edits.before:
impact:
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    timeout-minutes: 3
    outputs:
      mode: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.mode }}
      windows_shards: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.windows_shards }}
      posix_shards: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.posix_shards }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: '24.18.0'
      - name: Check feature branch history
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node scripts/check-pr-history.mjs
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --prefer-offline --no-audit --no-fund --fetch-retries=0 --fetch-timeout=30000
      - name: Validate concise agent entry points
        run: npm run check:guidance
      - name: Resolve exact comparison base
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
        run: |
          [[ "$BASE_SHA" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{40}$ ]]
          if ! git cat-file -e "${BASE_SHA}^{commit}"; then
            git -c credential.helper= -c http.lowSpeedLimit=1024 -c http.lowSpeedTime=30 fetch --depth=1 --no-tags origin "$BASE_SHA"
          fi
          git diff --check "$BASE_SHA" HEAD
      - name: Validate PR metadata
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PR_TITLE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}
        run: |
          title_pattern='^(feat|fix|chore|docs|refactor|test|perf|ci)(\([^)]+\))?!?: .+'
          [[ "$PR_TITLE" =~ $title_pattern ]]
      - id: plan
        run: node scripts/ci-impact.mjs
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: ci-impact
          path: ci-impact.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
edits.after:
impact:
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      pull-requests: read
      statuses: write
    timeout-minutes: 3
    outputs:
      mode: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.mode }}
      windows_shards: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.windows_shards }}
      posix_shards: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.posix_shards }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: '24.18.0'
      - name: Invalidate previous Full status for this attempt
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'develop' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node scripts/publish-full-quality.mjs --pending
      - name: Check feature branch history
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node scripts/check-pr-history.mjs
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --prefer-offline --no-audit --no-fund --fetch-retries=0 --fetch-timeout=30000
      - name: Validate concise agent entry points
        run: npm run check:guidance
      - name: Resolve exact comparison base
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        env:

          fi
          git diff --check "$BASE_SHA" HEAD
      - name: Validate PR metadata
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PR_TITLE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}
        run: |
          title_pattern='^(feat|fix|chore|docs|refactor|test|perf|ci)(\([^)]+\))?!?: .+'
          [[ "$PR_TITLE" =~ $title_pattern ]]
      - id: plan
        run: node scripts/ci-impact.mjs
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4

edits.before:
check:
    # Preserve the required check name. A skipped/cancelled/missing shard must
    # never turn the aggregate green; fail-fast=false collects all shard results.
    needs: [impact, rules, fast]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    timeout-minutes: 2
    steps:
      - name: Require every regression shard
        env:
          RULES_RESULT: ${{ needs.rules.result }}
        run: |
          test "${{ needs.impact.result }}" = success
          if [ "${{ needs.impact.outputs.mode }}" = full ]; then
            test "$RULES_RESULT" = success
          else
            test "${{ needs.impact.outputs.mode }}" = fast
            test "${{ needs.fast.result }}" = success
          fi
edits.after:
check:
    # Preserve the required check name. A skipped/cancelled/missing shard must
    # never turn the aggregate green; fail-fast=false collects all shard results.
    needs: [impact, rules, fast, presentation, engineering-posix]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    timeout-minutes: 2
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      pull-requests: read
      statuses: write
    steps:
      - name: Require every regression shard
        env:
          RULES_RESULT: ${{ needs.rules.result }}
        run: |
          test "${{ needs.impact.result }}" = success
          if [ "${{ needs.impact.outputs.mode }}" = full ]; then
            test "$RULES_RESULT" = success
          else
            test "${{ needs.impact.outputs.mode }}" = fast
            test "${{ needs.fast.result }}" = success
          fi
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        if: always() && github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'develop' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        if: always() && github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'develop' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
        with:
          node-version: '24.18.0'
      - name: Publish exact Full regression status
        if: always() && github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'develop' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          FULL_MODE: ${{ needs.impact.outputs.mode }}
          FULL_NEEDS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
        run: node scripts/publish-full-quality.mjs

branches: [develop, master]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review, labeled, unlabeled]
  push:
